chapter_keywords: a record of a mortal's journey to immortality
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 293: The Flame Show – Spiritual Roots & Social Tribulation
chapter_meta_description: Han Li watches a Qi Condensation Daoist perform dazzling flame transformations, nearly fooling him into thinking it's a mid-grade spell. A surprise spiritual root discovery shakes up Prince Xin's banquet in this social tribulation chapter.
og_title: RMJI Ch. 293: A False Fire Bird and a Surprise Disciple
og_description: A lazy glutton is chosen by fate, and an old master puts on a fire show that almost tricks even Han Li. Chapter 293 is all about perception, talent, and the art of looking powerful.
twitter_title: RMJI 293: The Power of Looking Good
twitter_description: A fat, useless noble is found to have a spiritual root, and an old Daoist's flame puppetry nearly fools a Foundation Establishment cultivator. Sometimes, control is better than raw power.

lore_anchors.definition: A basic fire-element spell that most fire-spiritual-root cultivators learn. It creates a fist-sized fireball for ranged attack.
A mid-grade elementary spell that conjures a large, destructive fire bird. Han Li has not yet mastered this spell himself.
The innate aptitude required to cultivate immortality. It has no correlation with a person's looks, intelligence, or social status—it is a random cosmic lottery.
The second major cultivation realm. A Foundation Establishment cultivator is a true immortal in the eyes of mortals, possessing far greater power and lifespan than a Qi Condensation cultivator.
A respectful title mortals use when addressing any cultivator, regardless of their actual rank or power.
